analyst.summary: Senco Gold delivered very strong growth this quarter - retail revenue up 48% and same-store sales up 38%, helped by a strong festive and wedding season - while continuing to expand its store network, increasingly through capital-light franchise partners. The stock trades cheaply relative to this growth, but that discount reflects real, recognized risks of the jewellery-retail business model: heavy working-capital and debt needs to finance gold inventory, thin differentiation in a competitive category, and exposure to gold-price and import-duty swings, not a straightforward bargain.
